Consumer court: ferroplan's HDDL gate
(`crates/ferroplan-hddl/examples/validate_files.rs`) —

rendered problems admit against this domain (parse + validate + ground;
ground_methods 6-10 per problem).

These fixtures exist so the emitted grammar is inspectable; the live court is
the `ferroplan validate_files round-trip` describe block in

on FERROPLAN_DIR + cargo).
